name: Glühwurm
prior: Kuramoto / firefly synchronisation exists as instruments, none of them a touch instrument coupling fingers and a sequencer: Våld Labs KURARE (open beta Sept 2026: polyphonic swarm synth, POPULATE up to 32 oscillators per swarm, DECOUPLE from synced tones to drifting clouds; VS: matrixsynth.com) is the newest and closest - a swarm inside one note, not fingers finding each other; Chiral Audio Foxfire (16-voice Kuramoto chorus that drifts, partially syncs, locks; VS: rekkerd.org); Luci modules by NLnRi for VCV Rack (firefly pulse synchronisation, 'Firefly Pulse' patch; VS via check biologist-glw.json, V); Kuramoto Drone browser synth (VS: mi.wrocenter.pl); Max/MSP Kuramoto-on-GPU patch (VS: cycling74.com); Processing synchronization library with a firefly example (VS: github archive-for-processing); Complexity Explorables 'Ride my Kuramotocycle' (VS). Academic: Mirollo & Strogatz 1990, Lem SMC 2019, NIME 2024 coupled oscillator networks (V: biologist-glw.json); Ermentrout 1991 'An adaptive model for synchrony in the firefly Pteroptyx malaccae' (J. Math. Biol. 29:571, DOI 10.1007/BF00164052: adaptation of the free-running period gives perfect synchrony; VS), frequency-adaptive Kuramoto (Taylor/Ott/Restrepo arXiv 0906.2124; inertial/hysteretic variants arXiv 1901.04804; VS). The Vactrol LPG is standard Eurorack (V performer.md §1 via musicians.md). In-app: biologist.md §1 proposes the same name/key as a worklet population under one finger (V); the adversarial check of that variant (V: biologist-glw.json) already asked to merge the two. Unoccupied after 2 searches here (plus the 3 of the sister check): the fingers themselves (and the Puls) as the coupled population of a touch instrument.

cost_detail.L1: OSC 0.03 + WaveShaper 0.03 + lowpass BQ 0.06 + 2 Gain 0.06 + k-rate detune ~ 0.2-0.3 (V webaudio.md §4); automation <= 4 setTargetAtTime calls per blink x <= 8 Hz = 32 events/s per voice - cheap, past events are dropped from the timeline (A); the idea's 0.35 is safe

failure_modes: [M] The default coupling does not deliver the pitch: K 0.8 with rates 1.5 Hz +-8 %: 2 fingers lock (r > 0.95 for 1 s) in 93 % of runs with a median of 1.6 s, 3 fingers in 77 % (median 3.4 s, up to 17 s), 5 fingers in 27 % (r 0.73) - pairs snap within 2 s like an LFO, chords of 4-5 fingers stay loose; '5-20 s finding each other' is the exception. Two-oscillator condition K >= |dOmega| with |dOmega| up to 1.51 rad/s: 22 % of pairs can never lock at K 0.8.

[M] Hoehe = rate x0.5-2 destroys the synchronisation it is meant to stage: fingers at y 0.45/0.5/0.55 (rates +-7 %) lock in 20 % (median 12.9 s), at +-0.1 y (+-15 %) in 7 %, at y 0.25/0.5/0.75 (x0.71-x1.41) never - even at K 3 (max). Phase coupling only locks oscillators of nearly equal rate; the described 'Blinkraten ziehen sich zueinander' is frequency adaptation (Ermentrout 1991, the real P. malaccae mechanism), which the spec does not contain.

[M] With frequency adaptation (omega_i += dt*adapt*(K/N)*sum sin) the pitch becomes true: +-15 % rates at K 0.8, adapt 1.0 -> 100 % locked, median 10 s (2-19 s); 5 fingers at the same y -> 100 % in a median 5.7 s - but x0.71-x1.41 still fails (7 % in 40 s): the y->rate range must shrink to <= +-0.25 octave or snap to 1:2:3 ratios.

One finger = an LPG-gated triangle at 1.5 Hz = a tremolo/auto-pluck pad (Nebel + square LFO); heat memory and the glut floor are subtle. The engine's identity needs >= 2 fingers or the Puls, which the performer admits - in the library it would be the one held engine that is dull solo, and dice()/Sporenregen/presets mostly play it solo.

Locked state = chord strobe in unison = trance gate; the identity is the transition. Pure phase coupling keeps a natural flam (r 0.9-0.97 in the sim, phase lag asin(dOmega/K)), adaptation removes it (r -> 1.00) -> adaptation must stop short (95 %) or jitter must be re-drawn, or the settled field is an LFO after all. Takt-Rast plus Puls phase makes it a sidechain gate on the grid: fine on stage, but then the 'big firefly' is quantisation.

Burst = one LPG pluck per lane step (Buchla bongo: distinct from Membran/Glocke, good), but each lane hit kicks every held phase with 0.5*K_p*sin(theta_p - theta_i): at 8 hits/s the field is dragged onto the grid in < 1 s -> kick <= 0.1 or only on accented steps.

Released voices 'glow until rel' (0.1-6 s) while listed in A.glwField: if they stop blinking the field changes abruptly, if they keep coupling they steer live fingers -> define: released voices keep blinking, stop coupling, leave the field at finish.

Fold pre-gain 0.6 + 1.6*fold*y reaches 2.2x into sin(1.5*pi*x) at y 1 = three folds of a triangle without oversampling at L1 -> aliasing sheen on high notes (A); cap pre at ~ 1.4 or lowpass before the fold.
fixes: frequency adaptation (Ermentrout): omega_i += dt*adapt*(K/N)*sum sin(theta_j - theta_i), adapt 0.5-1.0, relaxing to the own rate when alone; K default 1.2; Hoehe -> rate range +-0.25 octave (or none: Hoehe = fold/glow only) with 1:2:3 snapping to the lowest finger when |log ratio| < 0.2
keep a flam: adapt only to 95 % of the difference, per-finger +-5 % jitter re-drawn every ~ 10 s
lane kick <= 0.1*K_p; Takt-Rast default when SEQ.on, free when not; released voices blink but do not couple
L3 without shaper oversampling (pre-lowpass); 2 fireflies per finger

merge with biologist.md §1: this native per-finger design is the engine (works without a worklet), the worklet population is the L3 option; Spielhilfe 'zwei Finger gleich hoch – sie finden sich'; draw blinks in the field (visPush)
verdict: Selten, nicht neu: Kuramoto-/Leuchtkäfer-Synchronisation gibt es als Schwarm-Synth (Våld Labs KURARE 2026: Populate/Decouple), als Kuramoto-Chorus (Chiral Audio Foxfire), als VCV-Module (Luci), Browser-Drone und Max-Patch – unbesetzt bleibt, dass die Finger eines Touch-Instruments (und der Puls) selbst die gekoppelte Population sind; biologist.md schlägt denselben Namen vor, die Schwester-Prüfung verlangt schon die Zusammenführung. Nativ und mit ≈ 0,3 die zweitbilligste Halte-Engine (Stufe 3 ≈ 0,5 ohne Shaper-Oversampling, 0,9 damit), Tick, Puls-Phase (beatAt) und Horizont-Planung existieren. Gemessen hält die Spezifikation ihr Versprechen nicht: bei K 0,8 rasten zwei Finger in 1,6 s ein wie ein LFO, fünf Finger nur in 27 % der Läufe, und sobald die Finger verschieden hoch liegen (Höhe = Rate ×0,5–2), synchronisiert gar nichts mehr (±7 % Rate: 20 %, ±15 %: 7 %, ±0,25 Höhe: 0 % selbst bei K 3) – Phasenkopplung rastet nur fast gleiche Raten ein, das beschriebene „Blinkraten ziehen sich zueinander“ ist Frequenz-Adaptation (Ermentrout 1991, der echte Pteroptyx-Mechanismus), und mit ihr stimmt alles (±15 % Raten: 100 % Sync, Median 10 s; fünf Finger 5,7 s). Mit Adaptation, enger Höhe-Rate-Spanne (≤ ±¼ Oktave oder 1:2:3-Raster), erhaltenem Flam und kleinem Spur-Schubs ist es die Bühnennummer, die der Performer meint; allein gespielt bleibt es ein LPG-Tremolo-Pad – das einzige Halte-Instrument der Liste, das solo langweilt –, und im Puls ein hübscher Buchla-Bongo-Pluck, der die Fläche mitreißt.
